# Testing Instructions

# Unit Tests

Must cover:
- Business logic
- Validation
- Edge cases
- Failure paths

---

# Integration Tests

Must cover:
- Database interactions
- API endpoints
- External integrations

---

# Testing Principles

- Tests must be deterministic
- Avoid flaky tests
- Use Arrange / Act / Assert
- Mock only external dependencies

---

# Coverage Expectations

Add/update tests for:
- New features
- Bug fixes
- Refactors
- Behavioral changes

Do NOT leave untested business logic.
